user.title: New inventory
user.description: Track what you have at home and keep a shopping list topped up automatically.

data.name: Name
data.auto_add: Add low items to the shopping list
data.match_by_name: Also restock items typed into the list by hand
data.remove_completed: Remove bought items from the list

data_description.name: For example Home or Holiday house. Each inventory has its own items and sensors.
data_description.shopping_list: A to-do list (for example the built-in Shopping list). Leave empty to use the inventory on its own.
data_description.auto_add: When an item drops to or below its threshold, it is written to the shopping list.
data_description.auto_restock: Ticking an entry off the shopping list adds the bought amount back to the item.
data_description.match_by_name: A ticked-off entry such as “Milk” or “Milk (2 bottles)” restocks the item with that name.
data_description.remove_completed: Delete an entry from the list once it has been restocked, instead of leaving it ticked off.
data_description.expiring_days: Items whose date is this close count as expiring soon.

error.name_exists: An inventory with this name already exists.
